## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if there is one.

## Evidence

Show the real flow working: screenshots, video, or relevant command output. List checks run and their results. For docs, copy the commands and verify the links.

## Limits and risks

What did you not verify? For pairing or Send changes, describe the restart/reconnect check. Confirm the one-paste install and nearby pairing still work when relevant.

Remove private board content, credentials and live pairing codes before submitting. Disclose AI assistance if used.
